info.cls_ename: Master's Program, Department of Industrial Engineering and Systems Management

description.describe_ch: 本課程旨在提供同學產品創新與產品開發管理的基本知識與技術，做為實務上進行產品開發時之依據。
description.describe_eh: The course covers the management of product innovation and new product development (NPD). Topics include the concept of innovation, innovation process, the framework of innovation management, the generation, development and selection of new product concepts, the formulation and implementation of new product development programs. It focuses on the fundamentals of identifying and characterizing the dimensions of the process, positioning new products in the market place, and developing a new product development framework.

targets.describe_ch: 能用自己的詞彙定義產品創新與產品發展管理。
targets.describe_en: Be able to define product innovation and product development management with her own words.

targets.describe_ch: 能辨識出可引用產品創新管理之處，並能清楚表達其方法。
targets.describe_en: Be able to distinguish and make clear statement about the methodology where principles of production innovation management  can be addressed.

targets.describe_ch: 能利用產品發展管理的原理，評估產品發展系統，並提出可行方法。
targets.describe_en: Be able to use principles of management of NPD to evaluate a product development system and to propose a feasible methodology for implementation.
